reasons: The connected-full-graph theorem is subsumed by the stronger proved theorem requiring cycle rank at most one only in the weak component containing the query; migrating inbound edges promotes the actual frontier without mislabeling a widening as a narrowing.
The prior construction incorrectly described the unicycle case as unresolved and did not include the proved weak-component reduction.

target-estimand-replace: The old estimand used the forest-only path symbol \(\operatorname{OPT}\) as though it already named the causal minimum on the cycle-rank-one branch; this replacement keeps the same causal object while separating it from the identifying program.

estimand-functional-replace: The forest path formula alone is stale after promoting the exact frontier to relevant components of cycle rank one; the piecewise functional records the disconnected, tree, and unicycle maps proved by the replacement theorem.
The handle is no longer an open-problem placeholder: the connected unicycle program is complete, and component normalization localizes it to the query-relevant weak component.

verdict.note: Accepted sound handle/symbol and dependent proof additions; rejected replacement theorem and meta until rank-zero/no-directed-path gives +infinity with a reachability cut; retained old theorem meanwhile.
